contract: Whether the vendor's name and logo are suppressed is a single entitlement-derived value that must be resolved for the booking's event through the shared resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts — organization setting overriding team setting overriding user setting, identically for team-owned and personally-owned events — and every surface that renders or forwards branding (booking page, confirmation/reminder/rating emails, the pre-booking verification-code email, and post-payment notifications) must consume that resolved value rather than reading a raw hideBranding column off one entity.

defect_location.summary: The resolver exists and is correct: packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 applies the org override and :85-110/:116-181 branch team vs user. Only the booking-page server props consume it (apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:208, apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:311, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,104, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36), which is why only that page behaves. Every notification path bypasses it and reads the event owner's raw column: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2620,2804,2819 and packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:458,471 pass `!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding` into the workflow/mandatory-reminder scheduler, so a team-owned event (owner null) always keeps the mark and an org override is never applied; the same pattern appears at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:103, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:464, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:404, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:669 and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:186. After a paid booking, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:231 does the same for the BOOKING_PAID trigger. Reminders carry their own duplicate rule: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:519-535 defines a local shouldHideBranding that returns `booking.eventType.team.hideBranding` for a team event and `booking.user.hideBranding` otherwise, with no parent/organization override — this is exactly the team-vs-personal divergence reported, and its value reaches the rendered footer at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-83 and templates/emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-80 via `isBrandingDisabled`. The flag is threaded through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:53,93,159,213,248,262-280, emailReminderManager.ts:38,117,151,189,211 and scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,38,82, so any caller-supplied value overrides the correct resolution that EmailWorkflowService.ts:97,251-269 already performs via getHideBranding. The pre-booking verification-code mail never receives the flag at all: packages/features/auth/lib/verifyEmail.ts:88-118 calls sendEmailVerificationCode with only language/code/user, and a verbatim scan of packages/emails/auth-email-service.ts, packages/emails/templates/attendee-verify-email.ts and packages/emails/src/components/BaseEmailHtml.tsx finds no branding fork, so that template must gain one. The platform mirror apps/api/v2/src/modules/atoms/services/event-types-atom.service.ts:423 repeats the flat `team?.hideBranding || user?.hideBranding` rule, while the equivalent web payment page packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58-61 already calls shouldHideBrandingForEvent — the two disagree. Supporting selects must widen to fetch team/parent alongside owner: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:111, packages/features/bookings/lib/getBookingToDelete.ts:57, packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/getBooking.ts:40, packages/features/bookings/repositories/BookingRepository.ts:462, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:170,201, packages/prisma/selects/payment.ts:55-65. The paid-plan gate itself lives at apps/web/lib/isBrandingHidden.tsx:1-3.
